announcement.name: ACE Music v1
announcement.official_publisher_claim: ACE Music v1 ranked first on Artificial Analysis AA-Music-Vocal v1.1; separate from ACE-Step open models.
announcement.publisher_main_weights_promise_ambiguity: Secondary paraphrases of November 12 social post say 'model weights in next few weeks', but the official site explicitly names ACE Music v1 Flash (not flagship v1) for late-2026 open-source. Do not treat this as confirmed release of flagship.
announcement.official_promised_window: late 2026, not a binding or exact date

other_closed_variant.name: ACE Music v1.1 Preview
other_closed_variant.novelty: ABC-notation score planning and melody/MIDI conditioning; hosted preview, weights not confirmed public

announcement.caveat: Hosted model output rights/plan prices are not a license to its weights. Do not scrape private APIs or circumvent access.

independent_evaluation.interpretation: Observed vocal-music leaderboard lead (16 Elo) is not an established universal quality gap, especially for instrumental work. Confidence intervals overlap, no paired significance test verified.

ACE_Step_open_original.kind: original additional distilled XL 8-step music DiT, not mere serialization of 2B variant
ACE_Step_open_original.checkpoint_hf_weight_dtype: F32 according to HF tensor summary; publisher card says BF16 weight size ~18.8GB; actual selected file bytes and dtype must be frozen
ACE_Step_open_original.checkpoint_file_inventory_from_hf_html: 4 safetensors each approx 4.99GB, config, 1 model index, two custom Python files and silence_latent.pt (pickle), no full byte/hash verification
ACE_Step_open_original.runtime_license_text: MIT license at fixed code sha inspected
dependency_required_components: acestep-5Hz-lm-1.7B (trained composition planner, default with XL)
Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (text embedding, licensed separately if upstream license applies)
config/model registry, tokenizer and speaker/metadata assets only as required by inspected source
silence_latent.pt from XL repo; PyTorch pickle not blindly load
duplicate_avoidance: Exclude acetep-v15-turbo 2B DiT from full shared repository source unless separate selection justifies it
No GGUF/INT8/MLX converted copies of same XL trained state
Do not add XL base or XL SFT without task/quality evidence; XL base can extract/lego/complete, XL turbo standard tasks only
Do not assume ACE Music v1 Flash is derived from this exact training lineage
publisher_claims: 8 diffusion steps with no CFG; publisher says higher music quality than 2B
About 20 GB HF source F32 checkpoint, not guaranteed 18.8GB BF16 download
GPU 12GB with offload+INT8, 16GB with offload, 20GB without offload, 24GB for full XL+4B LM; manufacturer claims, hardware version/batch not verified
ACE_Step_open_original.rights_warning: The MIT model card and runtime code license do not independently prove underlying training data authorization. Publisher claims licensed/public-domain/synthetic data; no third-party audit or user output copyright guarantees.

research_holds.reason: ~20GB independent pretrained XL state with all editing tasks extract/lego/complete, but overlap and extra space; don't add without incremental-use proof
Official 10.1GB shared LM/vae/embedding/2B turbo bundle; use shared subcomponents as dependencies for XL, do not add 2B DiT as second selected trained model automatically
Separate trained 4B planner model enhances composition, but 1.7B default already present in shared repo and no measured increment.

release_acceptance_gates: Public publisher repo has immutable 40-char revision
Model license in full text, no licensing conflation with hosted service
Check exact learned weight files, dependency/shard SHAs and selected bytes; no duplicates
Check independent training vs prior 2B or XL base
Verify full learnt total parameters and 150B cap
Verify compute/backend/python/CUDA/ABI and user's physical disk with min 200GB free
